objective.stem: Marriage is the day when a man and a woman are joined as ___

Parenting means ___
objective.answer: feeding, teaching and caring for the children
distractors: building new houses for the rich
selling our goods in the market
driving to school every single morning

objective.stem: Which of these is NOT a duty of parents?
objective.answer: doing the child's own school homework for him
distractors: giving the children their daily food
making sure the child is clothed well
paying the school fees every term

objective.answer: the way of life of a people

objective.stem: Which of these is NOT an element of culture?

objective.answer: how we think and feel about a thing
distractors: a thing we buy at the market

objective.stem: Doing the right thing when nobody is looking is called ___
